title: freeze RC11 real-object trust handoff and AIOS-body execution contract

criteria: Contract names the exact trust handoff from external object transport into AIOS local verification.
Contract preserves AIOS-body-only scope and excludes mirror frontend, nginx, remote signer infrastructure, and production ring mutation.

Contract defines fail-closed cases for missing object URI, drift, quarantine fetch, signature, revocation, compatibility, rollback, exact approval, AgentCore, SecurityExecutionEngine, support/recovery, and authority broadening.
